videos.title: Radio 1 Breakfast
videos.description: Start your weekend mornings with Radio 1 Breakfast.

videos.title: Saturday Morning
videos.description: Tom Service with guests, stories and the perfect classical soundtrack for the weekend!

videos.title: Earlier... with Jools Holland
videos.description: Jools shares his lifelong passion for classical music with fascinating studio guests.

videos.title: Radio 3's Essential History of Classical Music
videos.description: The year is 1026. Monk Guido d'Arezzo causes a musical revolution with a new invention.

videos.title: Record Review
videos.description: Ben Gernon chooses his favourite recording of Gershwin's 'An American in Paris'.

videos.title: Sound of Cinema
videos.description: Your weekly roundup of the finest film scores and movie music with Edith Bowman.

videos.title: This Classical Life
videos.description: Saxophonist Jess Gillam hosts the weekly music show for people who like classical music and other stuff too. Music, eclectic playlists and chat, with a new special guest every week.

videos.title: Opera on 3
videos.description: Delivering the live experience of rare opera performances to the comfort of homes.

videos.title: New Generation Artists
videos.description: The BBC Radio 3 New Generation Artists Scheme helps to support talented musicians to reach the next stages of their careers and brings some of the world's most promising new talent to listeners across the UK through BBC Radio 3 broadcasts.

videos.title: Music Planet
videos.description: Global beats and roots music from every corner of the world, with live sessions from the biggest international names and the freshest emerging talent, classic tracks and new releases.

videos.title: New Music Show
videos.description: Kate Molleson and Tom Service showcase live performances, debuts, and interviews with various artists who are taking the world of experimental music by storm.

videos.title: Through the Night
videos.description: Radio hosts like Catriona Young, John Shea, and Jonathan Swain enliven the night with a curated selection of classical music and opera performances recorded across Europe.

videos.title: Radio 1 Breakfast
videos.description: Start your weekend mornings with Radio 1 Breakfast.

videos.title: Sunday Morning
videos.description: Sarah Walker presents classical music to reflect, restore, and refresh, including an Advent favourite by Lauridsen, a song with a flute solo suggesting the winding road to Bethlehem, and a journey on a three-horse sled depicted by Prokofiev.

videos.title: Private Passions
videos.description: Michael Berkeley's guests share their musical passions and reveal which pieces bring them joy and sustain them through hard times.

videos.title: Music Map
videos.description: Show host Sara Mohr-Pietsch explores a piece of classical music, travelling to it through a playlist of connected and contrasting sound worlds, and mapping it in a musical landscape.

videos.title: Music Matters
videos.description: Justin Webb explores the relationship between classical music and American politics.

videos.title: Jazz Record Requests
videos.description: Alyn Shipton presents jazz records of all styles as requested by you.

videos.title: The Early Music Show
videos.description: An exploration of early developments in the musical world.

videos.title: Choral Evensong
videos.description: Live from Blackburn Cathedral.

videos.title: Between the Ears
videos.description: Innovative and thought-provoking features on a wide variety of subjects.

videos.title: Sunday Feature
videos.description: In-depth documentaries which explore music, history, science, philosophy, film, visual arts, and literature.

videos.title: Words and Music
videos.description: A weekly journey of discovery, weaving together a range of music with poetry and prose read by leading actors.

videos.title: Brass Banding with Hannah Peel
videos.description: Hannah Peel celebrates the British brass band tradition.

videos.title: Night Tracks
videos.description: Sara Mohr-Pietsch presents an adventurous, immersive soundtrack for late-night listening, from classical to contemporary and everything in between.

videos.title: Unclassified
videos.description: Elizabeth Alker invites Belle and Sebastian's Stuart Murdoch to select a track.

videos.title: Through the Night
videos.description: Radio hosts like Catriona Young, John Shea, and Jonathan Swain enliven the night with a curated selection of classical music and opera performances recorded across Europe.

videos.title: Radio 1 Breakfast
videos.description: Start your weekend mornings with Radio 1 Breakfast.

videos.title: Essential Classics
videos.description: Georgia Mann plays the best in classical music for your morning.

videos.title: Classical Live
videos.description: Featuring classical music performances recorded at the proms and other events such as festivals, recitals, competitions, and more.

videos.title: Composer of the Week
videos.description: Donald Macleod presents an informative and accessible guide to composers and their music, with each week being dedicated to a particular composer or a group of related composers, focusing on their lives and works.

videos.title: In Tune
videos.description: Live music from The Tallis Scholars.

videos.title: Classical Mixtape
videos.description: Take time out with a 30-minute soundscape of classical favourites.

videos.title: Radio 3 in Concert
videos.description: Listen to the music from concerts around the world.

videos.title: The Essay
videos.description: Leading writers share their insight, opinion and intellectual surprise on arts, history, philosophy, science, religion and beyond, themed across a week.

videos.title: Night Tracks
videos.description: Sara Mohr-Pietsch presents an adventurous, immersive soundtrack for late-night listening, from classical to contemporary and everything in between.

videos.title: 'Round Midnight
videos.description: Soweto is joined by rising pianist Sultan Stevenson and his trio for an exclusive session.

videos.title: Through the Night
videos.description: Radio hosts like Catriona Young, John Shea, and Jonathan Swain enliven the night with a curated selection of classical music and opera performances recorded across Europe.
